text:

CHIEF JUSTICE ORDER

the Office of the State Court
Administrator
ORDER SETTING MISCELLANEOUS FEES
UNDER ORS 21.020(2) AND SUPERSEDING
CJO 05-039 and CJO 06-050
By virtue of the authority vested in me as Chief Justice of the Supreme Court by
ORS 1.002(1 )(a) and ORS 21.020(2), and except as provided in ORS 20.140, the following fees
shall be charged and collected by the appellate courts, Appellate Court Services Division, and
the Office of the State Court Administrator commencing February 1, 2013:
1. Affixing the seal of the court to a document
2. Official certificate with signature and seal
3. Paper copies of court records on file
4. Scanning and emailing document(s)
or data via email
5. Converting microfilmed documents to
digital format and emailing
6. Emailing document(s) or data currently
stored electronically
7. Certified copies of letters, records, or files
8. Each exemplification
9. Each check returned for any reason
10. For outgoing or incoming copies sent by facsimile (fax)
as a courtesy and convenience for parties,
public or counsel
11. Electronic duplication of judicial proceedings
12. Document, information, or data via compact disc
or other court-provided media
13. For segregation of protected personal information
when that information already exists in a document
in an appellate court case file

For purposes of this order, "page" means one side of a sheet of paper (14 inches or less long
and 8.5 inches or less wide). Courts are encouraged to print on both sides of the paper when
feasible. Actual costs for postage, packing, and freight may be charged when originals or
copies of records or files are mailed or shipped to individuals at their request when the total
weight of any one shipment: exceeds 1 ounce (first-class mail rate); exceeds standard 1 ounce
postage because of size; or is sent by express, priority, or by private carrier; or is shipped
outside the continental United States.
This order supersedes CJO 05-039 dated September 7, 2005, and CJO 06-050 dated
October 31, 2006.
